statement.excerpt: He's teamed up with Sam Altman, a guy who has categorically failed to build any new consumer-facing product outside of the launch of ChatGPT, a product that loses OpenAI billions of dollars a year, to do the only other thing that loses a bunch of money — building hardware.

from_speaker: categorically failed to build any new consumer-facing product outside of the launch of ChatGPT
a product that loses OpenAI billions of dollars a year
our_interpretation: The financial assertion concerns losses attributable to ChatGPT itself, not automatically all losses incurred by OpenAI.
Billions means multiple billions of US dollars in an annual period.
Use calendar 2024, the latest completed annual period before publication, for the ongoing annual-loss assertion.
The product assertion means a distinct consumer product launched under Altman's leadership. It does not require him to have personally engineered it.
No separate commercial-success threshold is supplied by the words build any new consumer-facing product.
The compound target period is the product record through publication; the financial component's narrower 2024 period is specified in metric_scope.
No accounting basis or financial source is identified in the supplied passage, so the contract's accounting basis remains unknown.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable product-level accounts show ChatGPT incurred multiple billions in annual losses, and the launch record establishes no other distinct consumer product under Altman's leadership.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable ChatGPT accounts show losses below the threshold, or a dated record establishes another distinct consumer product. Each component must be assessed separately.
